def band(seed,freq,size=1024,stretch=1):

 filtered=np.fft.ifft2(np.fft.fft2(raw)*np.exp(-.5*((fx*size/freq)**2+(fy*size/(freq*stretch))**2))).real
 return np.clip(filtered/max(filtered.std(),1e-6),-2.5,2.5)
slate=bpy.data.materials['HarborCraft_Terminal_Slate'];SL=1024;P=256

for v in range(16):
 yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:P,0:P];u=xx/(P-1)*.55;w=yy/(P-1)*.72
 body=band(911+v,5,P,.6);grain=band(977+v,65,P)
 # Deep warm-grey slate, with restrained mineral colour rather than blue paint.
 tone=body*2.1+grain*.45;h=.000085*grain+.00009*body
 for j in range(3):

 base=np.array([64,59,52])+((v%4)-1.5)*1.25

 rgb=base+tone[:,:,None]+dust[:,:,None]*np.array([13,11,7])

 x=v%4*P;y=v//4*P

# Heavy canvas: the emblem belongs to the textile, not two rigid strips.
N=1024;yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:N,0:N];u=xx/(N-1);v=yy/(N-1)
variation=band(121,5);fuzz=band(124,160)

def heavy_banner(name,cx,y,top,w,h,pointed=False):
 nx,nz=16,24;verts=[];faces=[]
 def pos(q,t):
  taper=(1-t*.88) if pointed else (1 if t<.78 else 1-.76*(t-.78)/.22)
  # Gravity folds hang from the two sewn top tabs; lower edge rolls a little.
  fold=(.010+.025*t)*math.sin(q*math.pi*5+.35*t)+.013*t*t*math.sin(q*11+t*3)
  belly=.015*math.sin(t*math.pi)
  return (cx+(q-.5)*w*taper,y+fold+belly,top-h*t-.007*math.sin(q*math.pi)*math.exp(-t*8))
 for j in range(nz+1):
  for i in range(nx+1):verts.append(pos(i/nx,j/nz))
 for j in range(nz):

   k=j*(nx+1)+i;faces.append((k,k+1,k+nx+2,k+nx+1))
 ob=mesh_obj(name,verts,faces,canvas);uv=ob.data.uv_layers.new(name='HarborSurfaceUV')
 for p in ob.data.polygons:
  p.use_smooth=True
  for li in p.loop_indices:
   vi=ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index;j,i=divmod(vi,nx+1);uv.data[li].uv=(i/nx,1-j/nz)
 so=ob.modifiers.new('Sewn canvas thickness','SOLIDIFY');so.thickness=.0025
 # Rolled hem follows the actual drape instead of drawing a straight border.
 for q in [.015,.985]:
  tube(name+' rolled hem',[pos(q,t) for t in np.linspace(0,1,34)],.0038,canvas,6)
 # Cloth tabs genuinely encircle the existing rod/bearer.
 for q in [.15,.85]:

  loop=[(px,y+.018*math.cos(a),top+.028+.022*math.sin(a)) for a in np.linspace(0,math.tau,20)]
  tube(name+' suspension tab',loop,.007,canvas,6)
 return ob

''',ns)
